## What the pattern says

- His good months are trends and breakouts out of ranges; his bad months are ranges. The setup did not change
  between them; the market did.
- After each bad period he cut size and trades per day before adding back (November 2025, March 2026).
- When the market trends for weeks, holding longer earns more than scalping (May 2026).
